title: Write Vitest unit tests for the scraping service
description: Write Vitest unit tests for the scraping client (TASK-15) that proxies to the Express sidecar. Mock the fetch calls.
acceptanceCriteria: All fetch calls are mocked with vi.mock or vi.spyOn
Tests cover: successful crawl returns structured data, network error returns error object, invalid URL returns error, sidecar unreachable returns error with helpful message

steps.description: Create test file and mock fetch
steps.details: Create src/lib/scraping/__tests__/scrapingClient.test.ts. Use `vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn())` to mock global fetch. Write tests for each scenario.

Test 1: mock fetch returns 200 with valid crawl data — verify client returns parsed result. Test 2: mock fetch throws network error — verify client returns { error: 'Crawl service unavailable' }. Test 3: mock fetch returns 400 — verify client returns error.
